model.shop.customer_orders.compiled_code:
select
    c.customer_id,
    c.first_name,
    count(o.order_id) as order_count,
    max(o.order_date) as last_order_date
from "bard"."shop_dev"."stg_customers" as c
join "bard"."shop_dev"."orders" as o on o.customer_id = c.customer_id

group by c.customer_id, c.first_name

model.shop.orders.compiled_code:
with  __dbt__cte__payments_eph as (


select order_id, payment_method, amount
from "bard"."shop_dev"."stg_payments"
where amount > 0
), payments as (
    select * from __dbt__cte__payments_eph
),

order_payments as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'credit_card' then amount else 0 end) as credit_card_amount,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'coupon' then amount else 0 end) as coupon_amount,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'bank_transfer' then amount else 0 end) as bank_transfer_amount
        
    from payments
    group by order_id
)

select
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.order_date,
    o.status,
    coalesce(p.credit_card_amount, 0) as credit_card_amount, coalesce(p.coupon_amount, 0) as coupon_amount, coalesce(p.bank_transfer_amount, 0) as bank_transfer_amount, 
    'us' as region
from "bard"."shop_dev"."orders_staging" as o
left join order_payments as p on p.order_id = o.order_id

where o.status = 'completed'

from "bard"."shop_dev"."stg_payments"

model.shop.revenue.compiled_code:
with __dbt__cte__payments_eph as (


select order_id, payment_method, amount
from "bard"."shop_dev"."stg_payments"
where amount > 0
) select
    payment_method,
    sum(amount) as revenue
from __dbt__cte__payments_eph
group by payment_method
